active_family: 663a bounded-IV state-aware normalized-innovation conditional law; first backend is AR flow matching but backend changes require protocol diagnostics
normalization_policy: support-aware encoded levels; daily encoded increments; history-only fixed EWMA/RMS scale with robust floor; zero center remains the deployable incumbent. 679a/680a falsified full EWMA mean centering as too deterministic even with rollout-energy repair; 681a falsified EWMA drift as an added conditioning feature because it still over-amplified drift/mean-reversion and damaged level/path allocation.
backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
current_bottleneck: 685a reframes the post-contrast failure as a path-prior mismatch risk. The AR flow uses iid Gaussian base noise per future step, forcing the transition to learn both temporal path coherence and history conditioning. Contrast objectives can improve normalized-innovation separability while worsening integrated level law, so the next clean axis is the base path prior rather than another loss term.
last_result_summary: 685a literature-backed ideation after 684a: TSFlow/ICLR 2025 motivates data-dependent Gaussian-process or temporally structured priors for flow-matching time-series generation; TACTiS-2 motivates joint-law/dependence modeling rather than post-hoc deck contrast; TimeGrad remains a core AR diffusion baseline. Decision: stop hard-negative contrast, keep 682a as best native joint38, and test a path-correlated base-noise prior in the same normalized-innovation AR flow.
next_step_recommendation: Implement the smallest generic path-correlated base-prior hook: estimate an AR(1) or exponential-kernel correlation for normalized innovations from training data, use correlated base noise consistently in teacher-forced flow training and free-running rollout sampling, then run a joint38 falsifier against 676a/682a. Keep architecture/data object fixed.
current_best_note: 510a/392a remain the historical short-frame best learned IV laws at 8/11. Within the clean general state-aware normalized-innovation family, 674a/675a remains the strongest IV-only candidate at 7/11, while 682a is now the best native joint38 checkpoint at 6/11 with acceptable anchor panel quality and preserved IV-factor co-movement.
